visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop has two thick, uneven contour strokes meeting at one pointed lower-left tip, with a narrow upper gap reserved for the cap. The shape is easy to place before details.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: All six saved JPG crops were compared in order after the final-panel repair. The body tip, three cap lobes, curved stem, right-side ridge, exactly three heat waves and two black shine curves remain in their assigned positions. No temporary guides appear, and no unexplained structural line disappears or moves. The final marker fill keeps visible paper streaks.

transitions.observed_addition: The tapered body and pointed lower-left tip remain fixed; a three-lobed cap closes the reserved top gap and one curved stem grows from it.
transitions.instruction_match: The cap instruction uses the open top endpoints and joins the stem to the cap.

transitions.observed_addition: The pepper body, cap and curved stem stay at their anchors; a slender ridge appears inside the right side of the pepper.
transitions.instruction_match: The ridge instruction places one curved line inside the right contour without touching the tip.

transitions.observed_addition: The body, cap, stem and inner ridge remain; exactly three separate wavy heat marks appear to the right at upper, middle and lower positions.
transitions.instruction_match: The heat instruction specifies three separated waves in the open right-side paper.

transitions.observed_addition: All three heat waves and pepper contours remain; two short black shine curves appear in the left interior, one high and one low.
transitions.instruction_match: The shine instruction locates both curves away from the right-side ridge.

transitions.observed_addition: The cap, stem, body, ridge, both black shine curves and three heat waves persist; streaky red fills the body and green fills the cap and stem.
transitions.instruction_match: The final coloring instruction applies marker inside existing contours and retains the black shine curves and waves.
